I found one problem on the pricing page and fixed it. It may not be the one you meant.

**What was wrong:** On phone-width screens (720px and narrower), the "Compare plans" table was cut off. The Team column ("Monthly" in particular) was only reachable by scrolling sideways.

**The fix:** I added a rule at the end of `site/css/pages.css`. At 720px and narrower, the pricing page's table cells get tighter padding and are allowed to wrap. All four columns now fit on screen. The rule only applies to the pricing page.

**What I checked:** The desktop layout (1280px) looks fine. The plan cards, the "Most popular" ribbon, the table and the FAQ all render correctly. The functional tests pass (16 of 16). A fresh 400px screenshot shows the table fitting.

**What I couldn't determine:** The repo has a single commit, so there was no "last change" to compare against. If you saw something different, such as a specific viewport or element, tell me and I'll look at that.

I haven't committed anything.

STATUS: DONE
